name: Uzuki Shirayuki
source:
"Fufu ♪ I'm still unreliable, but please keep an eye on me."

She is a calm and sweet young lady.
She is in charge of (mock) cuteness in the group.

Even the other members don't know about her private life. She is a mysterious girl in many ways.

Her mannerisms and naivete may suggest that she is a very young lady, but unconfirmed.

She is pure and kind to everyone, and she will suddenly hold your hand and look you straight in the eye. She is a natural captivating personality.

She has an unusually devoted fan base of elderly people.
Her hobby is reading.

Accompanying magical creature: Lop (rabbit)

[Based on the [url=https://whirlpool.co.jp/kemonomichi-gs/character/chara03.php]official website[/url]]
